echo "== step: add vault repo =="
sudo -n tee /etc/yum.repos.d/vault-centos7.repo >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[vault-centos7-base]
name=CentOS-7 Vault Base
baseurl=http://vault.centos.org/7.9.2009/os/x86_64/
gpgcheck=0
enabled=1
EOF

echo "== step: install httpd =="
sudo -n yum -y install httpd

echo "== step: configure lb =="
sudo -n tee /etc/httpd/conf.d/lb.conf >/dev/null <<'CONFEOF'
<Proxy "balancer://inventorycluster">
    BalancerMember "http://10.100.150.11:8080"
    BalancerMember "http://10.100.150.12:8080"
    ProxySet lbmethod=byrequests
</Proxy>

ProxyPreserveHost On
ProxyPass "/" "balancer://inventorycluster/"
ProxyPassReverse "/" "balancer://inventorycluster/"
CONFEOF

echo "== step: selinux allow httpd network connect =="
sudo -n setsebool -P httpd_can_network_connect 1

echo "== step: firewall =="
sudo -n firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=80/tcp
sudo -n firewall-cmd --reload

echo "== step: enable+start httpd =="
sudo -n systemctl enable httpd
sudo -n systemctl restart httpd
sleep 1
systemctl is-active httpd

echo "== step: verify lb locally, expect alternating backends =="
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  curl -sS -m 5 "http://127.0.0.1:80/inventory.cgi" | grep backend
done
